en.title: Perpetual Contract Vault
en.subtitle: Automatically buy back tokens using tax revenue, launch a perpetual market for the token, and distribute the resulting LP rewards to holders.
en.mechanism.summary: Every unit of tax revenue follows one transparent on-chain route.
en.hints.mevProtected: Scheduled through a protected execution channel
en.hints.batchCap: Limits the exposure of each buyback batch
en.hints.claimReady: Your {lp} reward is ready to claim.
en.hints.noReward: Rewards will appear after Vault LP is forwarded to holders.
en.hints.poolIdUnavailable: The MYX pool ID could not be read. Market links and manual creation are unavailable.
en.states.readyToProcess: The processing threshold has been reached
en.states.collectingTax: Collecting tax revenue for the next batch
en.states.vaultUnavailable: The Vault contract address is unavailable.
en.states.connectWallet: Connect your wallet to use Vault actions.
en.states.actionsUnavailable: Vault actions are unavailable in the current market phase.
en.notices.riskMissing: The host has not provided the current contract risk status. Review the Vault contract before transacting.
en.notices.permissionless: Reward claims and manual pool creation are on-chain actions. MYX handles external trading.
en.market.intro: A perpetual market is created automatically once {lp} exceeds $1,000 in value. You can also create it manually.
en.market.threshold: The pool is created automatically when its quote value reaches $1,000.
en.messages.deploySuccess: Pool creation transaction confirmed. Check the MYX market status.
en.errors.walletDisconnected: Connect a wallet before sending this transaction.
en.errors.wrongNetwork: Switch to the required network before continuing.
en.errors.insufficientFunds: Your wallet does not have enough balance for this transaction.
en.errors.simulationFailed: The action is not ready or could not pass simulation.
en.errors.txReverted: The Vault contract reverted this transaction.
en.errors.txFailed: The transaction failed. Check your wallet and try again.
en.errors.readFailed: Vault data could not be loaded. Check the contract binding and try again.
en.errors.vaultUnavailable: The Vault contract address is invalid. Reads and transactions have been disabled.
en.launch.title: Configure perpetual market
en.launch.description: Choose the MYX market quote asset and the native BNB tax processing thresholds. This form does not send transactions.
en.launch.quoteHint: This selects the perpetual market's asset, not the token launch payment asset. Vault launches use native BNB.
en.launch.minimumHint: Tax revenue must reach this amount before a buyback runs.
en.launch.maximumHint: Leave empty for no per-call cap. Smaller caps can reduce the price impact of each batch.
en.launch.nativeGas: Native BNB launch: gas refill threshold and refill amount are fixed at zero.
en.launch.unsupported: This form requires the BNB Chain MYX factory schema. Check the factory/network or use the default form.
en.launch.invalidMinimum: Enter a positive BNB amount with at most 18 decimal places.
en.launch.invalidMaximum: The processing cap must be at least the minimum amount, with at most 18 decimal places.
en.launch.valuesNotice: The host validates these values against the factory schema and owns final confirmation.

zh.title: 永续合约金库
zh.subtitle: 使用税收自动回购代币、创建代币的永续交易市场，并将生成的 LP 奖励分配给持有人。
zh.mechanism.summary: 每一笔税收都沿着同一条透明的链上路径执行。
zh.hints.mevProtected: 通过受保护的执行通道调度
zh.hints.batchCap: 限制每批回购的价格冲击风险
zh.hints.claimReady: 你的 {lp} 奖励已可领取。
zh.hints.noReward: 金库将 LP 分配给持有人后，奖励会显示在这里。
zh.hints.poolIdUnavailable: 无法读取 MYX 池子 ID，交易链接和手动创建暂不可用。
zh.states.processingScheduled: 受保护的回购任务已排队
zh.states.collectingTax: 正在为下一批处理积累税收
zh.states.connectWallet: 连接钱包后可使用金库操作。
zh.states.actionsUnavailable: 当前市场阶段暂不支持金库操作。
zh.notices.riskMissing: 宿主页面尚未提供当前合约风险状态，交易前请先确认金库合约。
zh.notices.permissionless: 领取奖励和手动创建池子为链上操作；外部交易由 MYX 提供。
zh.market.intro: {lp} 价值超过 1,000 美元后自动创建永续市场，也可手动创建。
zh.market.threshold: 当池子的报价资产价值达到 1,000 美元，自动创建池子。
zh.messages.deploySuccess: 池子创建交易已确认，请核对 MYX 市场状态。
zh.errors.walletDisconnected: 请先连接钱包再发送交易。
zh.errors.wrongNetwork: 请先切换到要求的网络。
zh.errors.insufficientFunds: 钱包余额不足，无法完成本次交易。
zh.errors.simulationFailed: 当前操作尚未就绪或未通过交易模拟。
zh.errors.txReverted: 金库合约已回退本次交易。
zh.errors.txFailed: 交易失败，请检查钱包后重试。
zh.errors.readFailed: 无法读取金库数据，请检查合约绑定后重试。
zh.errors.vaultUnavailable: 金库合约地址无效，读取和交易操作已禁用。
zh.launch.title: 配置永续市场
zh.launch.description: 选择 MYX 市场报价资产和原生 BNB 税收处理门槛。本表单不会发送交易。
zh.launch.quoteHint: 这是永续市场的报价资产，不是发币支付资产；金库发币使用原生 BNB。
zh.launch.minimumHint: 累计税收达到此金额后，才执行回购。
zh.launch.maximumHint: 留空表示不限制单次处理金额。较小的上限可降低每批回购的价格冲击。
zh.launch.nativeGas: 原生 BNB 发币：Gas 补充阈值和补充金额固定为零。
zh.launch.unsupported: 此表单需要 BNB Chain MYX Factory 的参数定义。请检查网络和 Factory，或使用默认表单。
zh.launch.invalidMinimum: 请输入大于零的 BNB 金额，最多支持 18 位小数。
zh.launch.invalidMaximum: 单次处理上限不能小于最低处理金额，最多支持 18 位小数。
zh.launch.valuesNotice: 宿主会按 Factory 参数定义校验这些值，并负责最终确认。
